# Initial Set Up

```{r}
# loading in libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(infer)
library(randomForest)
library(tidymodels)
library(modelr)
library(yardstick)
set.seed(101422)
```



```{r}
# loading in data
load('../../data/biomarker-clean.RData')
```

## Splitting Data Into Training and Testing

```{r}
# splitting data
split_biomarker_clean <- biomarker_clean %>%
  initial_split(strata = group, prop = 0.75)

train_biomarker_clean <- training(split_biomarker_clean)
test_biomarker_clean <- testing(split_biomarker_clean)
```

# Multiple Testing

```{r}
# function to compute tests
test_fn <- function(.df){
  t_test(.df, 
         formula = level ~ group,
         order = c('ASD', 'TD'),
         alternative = 'two-sided',
         var.equal = F)
}
```

```{r}
ttests_out <- train_biomarker_clean %>%
  # drop ADOS score
  select(-ados) %>%
  # arrange in long format
  pivot_longer(-group, 
               names_to = 'protein', 
               values_to = 'level') %>%
  # nest by protein
  nest(data = c(level, group)) %>% 
  # compute t tests
  mutate(ttest = map(data, test_fn)) %>%
  unnest(ttest) %>%
  # sort by p-value
  arrange(p_value) %>%
  # multiple testing correction
  mutate(m = n(),
         hm = log(m) + 1/(2*m) - digamma(1),
         rank = row_number(),
         p.adj = m*hm*p_value/rank)
```

## Selecting 15 Predictive Proteins 

```{r}
# select significant proteins
proteins_s1 <- ttests_out %>%
  slice_min(p.adj, n = 15) %>%
  pull(protein)
```

# Random Forest

```{r}
# store predictors and response separately
predictors <- train_biomarker_clean %>%
  select(-c(group, ados))

response <- train_biomarker_clean %>% pull(group) %>% factor()
```

```{r}
# fit RF
rf_out <- randomForest(x = predictors, 
                       y = response, 
                       ntree = 1000, 
                       importance = T)

# check errors
rf_out$confusion
```

## Selecting 15 Predictive Proteins 

```{r}
# compute importance scores
proteins_s2 <- rf_out$importance %>% 
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(protein = rownames(rf_out$importance)) %>%
  slice_max(MeanDecreaseGini, n = 15) %>%
  pull(protein)
```


# Logistic Regression (INCOMPLETE)

## Fuzzy Intersection
fuzzy intersection: proteins in proteins_s1 or proteins_s2

```{r}
# select subset of interest
proteins_sstar <- unique(c(proteins_s1, proteins_s2))
```

```{r}
# preprocessing function
prep_func <- function(.df){
  .df %>%
    select(group, any_of(proteins_sstar)) %>%
    mutate(class = (group == 'ASD')) %>%
    select(-group)
}
```

```{r}
# prep_func applied to train and test
train_biomarker_sstar <- prep_func(train_biomarker_clean)
test_biomarker_sstar <- prep_func(test_biomarker_clean)
```

```{r}
fit <- glm(class ~ ., data = train_biomarker_sstar, family = 'binomial')
```
